label: About
title: About The Sky Keeps the Silence
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1213 recent saved-signal files and 321 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around FLYING SAUCER ATTACK John Peel 1st March 1996 and @vvvdotso: new feature is live!🥵 our juicy take on packs- BURSTS - rip one open or crack a..., plus 7 more. A source image from img.youtube.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Sky Keeps the Silence: An ochre duotone overprint world, poster crop, frontal reproduction with compressed photographic depth. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Irregular dark overprint around the large left portrait, Smaller right portrait with a sweeping dark hair contour, and Narrow yellow slit within the left overprint.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
